source: 753 Rational Franca
target: 753 Rationabilis Franca

source: Facing Franca’s probing, Lumian raised an eyebrow and said, “I’ve again come across something important that I need to tell you.”
target: Ad indagationem Francae obstante, Lumian supercilium levatum fecerat et dixit: “Iterum aliquid maximi momenti reperivi, quod tibi narrare debeo.”

source: Franca eyed Lumian suspiciously, unsure whether he was playing a prank or had actually discovered something new.
target: Franca Lumian suspicie intuens, nesciens utrum iocus faceretur aut vere aliquid novi invenerit.

source: Given the frequency of his discoveries, it seemed a bit much, didn’t it?
target: Ex frequentia inventionum eius, videbatur paulum nimis esse, nonne?

source: Just this morning, he had returned from the Blue Avenger, having completed an initial exploration that yielded the formula for the Demoness of Despair potion, a Sword of Courage equivalent to a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, and a specially significant corpse wax candle—all important findings. And now he had more gains in the afternoon?
target: Modo mane redierat ab Caeruleo Vindex, explorationem primam perfecerat quae attulit formulam poculi daemonissae desperationis, gladium virtutis, quod gradus primus sigillatum artificium aequipollens esset, atque candelam ceratam cadaveris peculiaris momenti—omnia res magni momenti repertae. Et nunc post meridiem plura adeptus est?

source: Ultimately, Franca chose to believe Lumian; after all, he had proven himself a harbinger of chaos on multiple occasions.
target: Denique Franca decrevit Lumiano credere, quippe se pluries praenuntiatorem tumultus ostendisse.

source: She stepped aside to let him into the living room.
target: Ea se recessit ut eum in conclave introiret.

source: “What’s it about this time?” Franca asked gravely as she closed the door.
target: “Quid hoc tempore est?” quaesivit Franca graviter, dum ostium clauderat.

source: Lumian stood by the window, back to the outside, and said seriously, “Do you remember Mr.
target: Hanged Man’s description of Harrison?”

source: “I remember—he might appear in places closely linked to darkness, death, dusk, and decay,” Franca replied, the oppressive atmosphere stifling her usual retort of not having forgotten what was discussed just that morning.
target: “Memini—ille forsitan apparere potest in locis arcte coniunctis cum tenebris, morte, crepusculo et corruptione,” respondit Franca, dum opprimens atmosphaera eius solitam replicationem de mane dicta non oblivisse prohibebat.

source: Lumian nodded and continued, “I had some free time, so I went to the catacombs. I met with the administrator guarding the Samaritan Women’s Spring area. He told me that recently, an outsider tried to approach the spring but was stopped by him. This outsider’s features are quite different from anyone from the Northern Continent…”
target: Lumian annuit et perrexit: “Aliquam temporis liberi mihi contigit, itaque ad catacumbas accessi. Conveni cum administrador, qui regionem Fontis Samaritarum Mulierum custodivit. Narravit mihi nuper externum fuisse, qui fontem appropinquare conatus est, sed a me prohibitus est. Eius externa lineamenta plane differunt ab iis, qui in Continente Septentrionali oriuntur…”

source: Franca, initially confused, shivered instinctively and blurted out, “Harrison? Was the man with the Eastern features that Jenna and I met actually Harrison?”
target: Franca, prima rursus confusa, tremore instinctivo commota, subito exclamavit: “Harrison? Num vir, cuius lineamenta orientalibus insignes sunt, quem Jenna et ego convenimus, vere Harrison fuit?”

source: She immediately recalled her and Jenna’s adventure at the Krismona Night Pillar.
target: Statim meminit adventurae suae et Jennae ad Columnam Nocturnam Krismonae.

source: In her urgency, she replaced the more complex description of non–North-Continent-bearing features with “Eastern features.”
target: In festinatione sua, descriptionem magis intricata lineamentorum non continentium septentrionalium substituit in “lineamenta orientalia.”

source: “It’s very likely.” Lumian nodded slowly.
target: “Id verisimile est,” Lumian lente annuit.

source: Franca was taken aback. “Resurrection Island… Resurrection Island!”
target: Franca obstupefacta est. “Insula Resurrectionis… Insula Resurrectionis!”

source: Her lake-blue eyes sparkled with excitement and anticipation.
target: Oculi eius, caerulei ut lacus, scintillabant ex laetitia et spe.

source: She asked for confirmation, “Could Resurrection Island be a node where the two worlds converge?”
target: Ea quaesivit confirmationem: “Num Insula Resurrectionis sit nodus quo duae mundi confluant?”

source: “Even if it’s not, it’s probably closely related to your world,” Lumian said, not wanting to dampen her spirits.
target: “Etiamsi non sit, verisimiliter ad mundum tuum arcte pertineat,” inquit Lumian, ne animum eius deprimeret.

source: Franca paced back and forth excitedly, then wailed, “Why didn’t I recognize him then? Why didn’t I capture him? Now he’s gone and we don’t even have a starting point! The Eternal Blazing Sun Church is too slow, not a single piece of feedback!”
target: Franca alacer per spatiolum circumegrebatur, deinde ululavit: “Cur tunc eum non agnovi? Cur eum non ceperam? Nunc evanuit, nec initium quidem habemus! Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Incendii nimis tarda est, ne una quidem responsione!”

source: After Franca vented her frustration, Lumian calmly said, “You can’t blame 007 and the others for being slow; Harrison might no longer be in Trier.”
target: Postquam Franca frustrationem suam effudit, Lumian tranquille dixit: “Non potes 007 et reliquos in tarditate culpare; Harrison fortasse iam non in Trier adest.”

source: “Mmm,” Franca pondered aloud. “I’ll announce this at the research society meeting so members in different areas can watch out for anyone resembling Harrison.”
target: “Mmm,” Franca voce meditabunda exclamavit: “Hoc in conventu societatis investigationis enuntiam, ut membra diversarum regionum vigilent, si quis Harrison similis appareat.”

source: Before Lumian could caution her, Franca muttered to herself, “I’ll tell them not to seek the island until we find Harrison and obtain detailed information about Resurrection Island. It’s too dangerous. If they spot Harrison, they shouldn’t rush to recognize him or approach him; pretend they haven’t seen him and notify President Gandalf, the chairman, Madame Hela, and us…”
target: Antequam Lumian eam monere posset, Franca sibi murmurat: “Eis dicam ne insulam quærant, donec Harrison inveniamus et accuratas notitias de Insula Resurrectionis colligamus. Nimis periculosum est. Si Harrison conspecti erunt, non festinanter eum agnoscant neque ad eum accedant; simulent se eum non vidisse et nuntent Praesidem Gandalf, praefectum, Dominam Hela, et nos…”

source: Lumian listened intently and then playfully complimented her, “I thought you’d be too excited to think straight. But surprisingly, you, who usually seem carefree and not too thoughtful, have considered everything quite thoroughly.”
target: Lumian attente auscultavit, deinde ludenter eam elogio complectus dicens: “Putabam te nimis excitatam fore ut recte cogitaris; sed, ad mirum, tu, quae plerumque leviter videaris et parum sollicita, omnia diligenter perspexisti.”

source: Franca wasn’t provoked; she replied with a smug grin, “What do you call that? Lü Duan is never muddled in major matters! If I have to think hard all the time, wouldn’t that negate the point of relaxing?”
target: Franca, non stimulata, respondit cum risu superbo: “Quid hoc vocas? Lü Duan numquam in rebus gravibus confunditur! Si omni tempore vehementer cogitare debeam, num id non revocat finem quietis?”

source: That made some sense… Lumian asked, puzzled, “Who’s Lü Duan?”
target: Quod aliquatenus sensum habet… Lumian, perplectus, interrogavit: “Quis est Lü Duan?”

source: “No need to know!” Franca answered decisively.
target: “Nihil scire opus est!” respondit Franca ferme.

source: Lumian guessed the reason and didn’t press further, simply nodding. “We’ll share this at the gathering in two days.”
target: Lumian causam coniunxit neque ultra insistere volens, simpliciter annuens: “Hoc in conventu post duos dies communicabimus.”

source: Franca hummed in agreement, then her excitement and joy vanished, her body trembling slightly.
target: Franca submurmuravit in assentimento, deinde laetitia et exsultatio eius evanuerunt, et corpus paulum trepidans factum est.

source: “What’s wrong?” Lumian asked with concern.
target: “Quid accidit?” rogavit Lumian sollicite.

source: Franca pressed her lips together, speaking softly, “I’m excited about the truth and what the future might hold, but I’m also afraid it won’t meet my expectations. I’m scared of facing an answer I can’t handle.”
target: Franca labris conpressis leniter loquens dixit: “Ex veritate et de futuris rebus excito, sed etiam timeo ne ea exspectationibus meis non respondeant. Metuo responsum, quod sustinere non valeam.”

source: After speaking, Franca leaned on the windowsill as if drained of strength.
target: Postquam locuta est, Franca in margine fenestrae inclinavit, quasi vi tota exhaurita.

source: Lumian offered no comfort, his look one and the same as that Madam Magician had when she looked at him: pity.
target: Lumian nihil solatium attulit; vultus eius idem erat ac illius Magistrae Magicae, quae eum intuens misericordiam ostendebat.

source: He too feared that the hope for resurrection he so desperately pursued might just be an unattainable illusion.
target: Et ipse timebat spem resurrectionis, quam tam vehementer petebat, esse tantum inaccessibilem illusionem.

source: After a moment, Lumian asked, “Want to have a drink?”
target: Post aliquod tempus, Lumian interrogavit: “Visne potum habere?”

source: “Sure,” Franca responded with a complex smile. “Getting drunk might help me forget these worries. Ah, typical brotherly comfort—offering a drink.”
target: “Certe,” respondit Franca cum risu multiplex: “In ebrietate forsitan has curas obliviscar. Ah, solatium fraternum typicum, potum offerens!”

source: Two days later.
target: Post duos dies.

source: Franca met with Demoness of Black Clarice, at a hunting ground on the edge of the East Lognes Forest, as agreed.
target: Franca convenit cum Daemonissa Nigra Clarice in campo venationis ad marginem Silvae Orientalis Lognes, ut fecerat conventum.

source: The demigod-level Demoness had swapped her usual black court gown for dark hunting attire and a black hat that covered her long hair, giving her an air of dashing elegance and freshness.
target: Daemonissa, dignitate semidea, solitam vestem curiam nigram mutaverat in vestem venatorem obscuram atque galeram nigram, quae capillos longos operiebatur, efficiens ut indoles eius esset audax elegantia et recenti fulgore.

source: Compared to her previously melancholic beauty, Madame Clarice now radiated a different kind of allure, equally captivating and splendid. Franca eyed the Demoness of Black with appreciation, suppressing the desires that instinctively arose, and relayed the intelligence on the Mirror People that 007 had provided in detail.
target: Comparata pulchritudine tristissima priore, Domina Clarice nunc aliam speciem amoenitatis exsudabat, aeque captivam atque splendidam. Franca Daemonissam Nigram cum admiratione intuens, instinctu orta desideria cohibens, notitiam de Speculorum Populo, quam 007 minutatim tradiderat, narravit.

source: Clarice nodded gently, her smile bright as she took a wooden, burgundy-colored briefcase from her horse.
target: Clarice leniter annuit, ridente praeclaro, dum a suo equo capsam ligneam coloris burgundii arripiebat.

source: “This is your reward,” said the Demoness of Black as she handed the case to Franca.
target: “Hoc est praemium tuum,” inquit Daemonissa Nigra, dum cistam Francae tradidit.

source: Franca did not hesitate, thanking her as she unlatched the metal fasteners and opened the modest-sized wooden briefcase.
target: Franca non dubitavit; gratias egit, dum vincula metallica soluta et cistam ligneam modestam aperuit.

source: Inside, the case was divided by pristine ice blocks showing no signs of melting, each compartment containing a bat’s head with colorful markings, a gallbladder oozing blood and green bile, a bifurcated tail covered with sleek, sinister scales, and two types of dark red blood in glass vials.
target: Intus, cista subdivisa erat in compartimenta glacie purissima constituta, quae liquefactionis ullum signum non ostenderat; singula compartimenta continebat: caput vespertilionis variis notis coloratis, vesicam felleam sanguine et bile viridi stillantem, caudam bifurcatam lamellis nitidis et sinistris opertam, atque duo genera sanguinis rubri obscuri in vitreis.

source: “Affliction’s main ingredient and most of the supplementary ingredients are here. If you’re not ready to advance, don’t try to break the ice I’ve crafted. That would only infect the bearer with various diseases and lead to a slow death,” warned the Demoness of Black.
target: “Ingrediens praecipua afflictionis et pleraque supplementaria hic sunt. Si ad progressum nondum parata es, noli conari glaciem quam ego condidi rumpere; id tantum ferentem variis morbis inficiat et ad mortem tardam ducat,” admonuit Daemonissa Nigra.

source: “Thank you, Madame,” Franca quickly counted what supplementary ingredients were still needed.
target: “Gratias tibi, Domina,” celeriter enumeravit Franca quae supplementaria adhuc necessaria essent.

source: All that was missing was the fairly common Enfinitas Eucalyptus.
target: Omne quod defuit erat Enfinitas Eucalyptus, satis communis.

source: Demoness of Black Clarice commented, “You’re very efficient and effective in your tasks.
target: Daemonissa Nigra Clarice inquit: “Es valde efficax et diligens in officiis tuis.

source: Perhaps in another year or two, you’ll be ready to attempt opening the gate to godhood. But then, we won’t reward you with the formula and ingredients for Despair. Instead, we’ll inform you of the advancement ritual in advance. Once you’re nearly ready, we’ll simply give you the Despair potion.”
target: Forsitan in alio anno vel biennio, paratus eris portam deitatis aperiendi conari. Tunc autem non tibi dabimus formulam atque ingredienta desperationis; immo, caerimoniam progressionis praeveniemus. Cum paene paratus eris, tibi simpliciter poculum desperationis praestitabimus.

source: “Is this to prevent High-Sequence potion formulas from being leaked?” Franca asked, understanding dawning on her.
target: “Num hoc est ad impediendum ut formulae poculi Ordinis Altissimi effundantur?” rogavit Franca, dum paulatim intellectus eam complectebatur.

source: The Demoness of Black nodded.
target: Daemonissa Nigra annuit.

source: “Once you earn the right to have a color precede your title, you’ll truly access the High-Sequence potion formulas and some of the sect’s secrets.”
target: “Cum ius tibi comparaveris ut color titulum tuum praeveniat, vere formulae poculi Ordinis Altissimi atque quaedam secreta sectae tibi patefientur.”

source: I also want to obtain the Demoness of Unaging potion formula from you all, but without becoming a Demoness of Unaging, I probably can’t have a color precede my name… No matter, having prior knowledge of the ritual to see if it’s wicked or not is sufficient… Franca didn’t hide the anticipation in her expression.
target: Etiam cupio a vobis formulam poculi Daemonissae Immortalitatis obtinere, sed sine Daemonissa Immortalitatis fieri probabiliter colorem nomini meo praeferre non possum… Nihil refert; scientia praevia caerimoniae nos certiores facit utrum nefaria sit. Franca expectationem in vultu suo non celavit.

source: She then steered the conversation back to the investigation of the Mirror People.
target: Deinde sermonem ad indagationem Speculorum Populi redegit.

source: “Madame, to what extent should we pursue the Mirror People? Is it enough to thwart their plans and eliminate those who have escaped from the special mirror world?
target: “Domina, usque quo Speculorum Populum persequendum sit? Estne satis consilia eorum impediere atque eos, qui ex mundo speculari speciali effugerunt, delere?”

source: “We couldn’t possibly enter that special mirror world and eradicate their leaders and their foundation while Fourth Epoch Trier’s seal remains intact, could we?”
target: “Nonne possumus in illud speculare mundum specialem intrare et duces atque fundamenta eorum exterminare, dum sigillum Quartae Aetatis Trier intactus manet?”

source: Franca was probing the Demoness Sect’s ultimate goal regarding the Mirror People, trying to gauge the state and thoughts of the Primordial Demoness.
target: Franca de ultimo proposito Sectae Daemonissarum circa Speculorum Populum percontabatur, quaerens statum atque cogitationes Daemonissae Primordialis intellegere.

source: Clarice looked at her and said with a refreshing smile, “Let’s do what we can for now. When you’ve advanced to Affliction, we’ll tell you more.”
target: Clarice eam contemplata, risu recenter nitido afferente, dixit: “Quod nunc possumus ageamus; cum ad Afflictionem pervenieris, tibi plura dicemus.”

source: Becoming a Demoness of Affliction means entering the core circle of the Demoness Sect, eligible to learn some secrets? Franca was both excited to be drawing closer to the secrets of the Demoness Sect and completing tasks, and somewhat anxious.
target: Fieri Daemonissa Afflictionis significat intrare in nucleum Sectae Daemonissarum, unde quaedam arcana disci possunt; Franca tum excitata, prope arcana sectae attingens et opera peragenda conficiens, et aliquantum anxia fuit.

source: Late at night, in a quarry cave in Underground Trier.
target: Sero nocte, in spelunca fodina in subterraneo Trier.

source: Angoulême de François, dressed in a brown woolen coat and wearing a gold brooch, entered this dormant area carrying a carbide lamp.
target: Angoulême de François, veste lana fusca indutus et fibula aurea gerens, hanc quietam aream intravit, lampam carbidicam ferens.

source: His right sleeve was rolled up, revealing a glass syringe tied around his elbow filled with a cloudy white liquid.
target: Manica dextra evoluta erat, ostendens syringeam vitrei circa cubitum alligatam, quae liquorem album turbido implebat.

source: Behind him followed four or five Purifiers, each with a similar syringe on their arms.
target: Post eum quattuor vel quinque Purificatores sequebantur, unusquisque brachio simili syringea habens.

source: Surrounded by the Purifiers were four tall iron-gray steam robots, responsible for carrying an item over two meters long and about six feet wide.
target: Circumdati a Purificatoribus erant quattuor automata vaporis ferro-grisea alta, quae munus habebant portandi rem quae plus quam duo metra longitudo et circiter sex pedes latitudo habebat.

source: The item was covered with a red flannel cloth, hiding any details.
target: Res tegebatur pannus flannel ruber, quo omnia singularia abscondebantur.

source: Angoulême stopped in the middle of the quarry, gesturing for his teammates to halt as well.
target: Angoulême in medio fodinae subsedit, gesticulans ut socios suos quoque sisterent.

source: The iron-gray steam robots then set the item on the ground.
target: Automata vaporis ferro-grisea deinde rem in terram posuerunt.

source: As the flannel cover was lifted, a beautifully crafted, classical-looking bed was revealed, making Angoulême and his team feel tired and drawn to its inviting comfort, wanting to lie down for a good sleep.
target: Cum pannus flannel sublevatus esset, lectus elegans et more classico apparens revelatus est, faciens Angoulême et turma eius fesses et ad solacium eius invitantem trahi, ut ad bonum somnum iacere concilirent.

source: Angoulême quickly looked away and, using the hand holding the carbide lamp, pushed the plunger of the syringe, injecting more of the liquid into his body.
target: Angoulême celeriter oculos avertit et, manu lampam carbidicam tenente, pistonem syringeae impulsit, plura liquoris in corpus suum iniectens.

source: Following similar actions from the other Purifiers, a figure in a black nun’s outfit suddenly emerged from the other side of the quarry.
target: Post similiora acta a ceteris Purificatoribus, figura in habitu monialis nigrae subito ex altera parte fodinae apparuit.
